text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Phew.
How was that, Trainer?

I show her the stopwatch.
It fell short... of our target time.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Mumu... Even if I enter, the chances of
putting up a good fight in the Satsuki Sho are slim, huh...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: How are the fans doing, I wonder?
choice_data_list: My impression is that you've reached your goal.

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to her self-producing efforts, her fan base grew significantly.
Hardcore fans were beginning to form as well.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Right. ...Yeah, if that's the case—then yeah.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I've made up my mind. I—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I won't run in the Satsuki Sho!
choice_data_list: Huh, you're not running!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, missing out is tough.
But rather than running poorly and getting written off—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "I think we should look on the bright side of 'not running' and make the most of it...!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
So, through self-producing!
I'll capture the race fans' attention!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: And so... Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Would you become an actor for me?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Preparations for the Satsuki Sho are going well so far.
While she fell just short in the graded races,
there are positives, such as increased muscle mass.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure, a GⅠ victory.
I will challenge the Satsuki Sho with my back against the wall.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket, how is Narita Taishin doing?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've leaned down, my body feels so light and great!
Ehehe, I'm definitely in top form for the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I've always, always dreamed of it!
Becoming a Derby Umamusume and giving dreams to everyone!
That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Dummy.
It's the Satsuki Sho, I told you.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah! S-Sorry!
Thanks, Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I hope I can run a race in the Satsuki Sho
that will pave the way to the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I... won't lose
when it comes to a burst of sharpness.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'll run past every last one of them from behind.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Are there any further questions?
...Seeing none, we will now conclude the press conference
announcing the entry for the "Satsuki Sho."
Huh!? W-What do you mean by that!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Hm? What was that voice just now?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: From the neighboring waiting room...?
Foregoing the Satsuki Sho... No way...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You told me the Satsuki Sho was next!
So... why...?!
choice_data_list: Sorry... This decision was made with the future in mind.
Sorry... It's a choice made with your future in mind.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Looking ahead...? You do realize you only get one chance in a lifetime at the Classic Triple Crown, right?
choice_data_list: To make it in time, I'll have to push myself too hard...

text_block_list.text:
I advise her that she has no chance of winning in her current condition.
She might manage if she pushes herself considerably... but pushing herself risks injury.
choice_data_list: This is all for the sake of your racing career that lies ahead.
This is all for the sake of your racing career that lies ahead.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That is... I understand that.
However...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: “But... to give up on the Satsuki Sho...!”

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Uuuuugh...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
She can't participate, huh?
Poor thing...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
There must be a good reason for it.
As far as the Trainer's judgment goes—
choice_data_list: Your talent is made for Tokyo!
Your talents are practically made for Tokyo!

text_block_list.text:
Tokyo Racecourse's long home stretch is ideal for her,
since she can sustain a great burst of speed.
—I passionately argued my case.
choice_data_list: That's why I'm betting it all on the Japan Derby!
That's why I'm betting it all on the Japan Derby!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: The Derby...?
choice_data_list: We can still make it to the Derby! You've got the aptitude for it too!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
In the Derby...
I will show my very best run...—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
For that reason,
I will give up on the Satsuki Sho...
choice_data_list: Yeah. Sorry...
Yeah. I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "...I'm sure you must have agonized over this time and time again too, Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...This is the path that you fretted over
and guided me toward.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I will move forward with faith, too...!
choice_data_list: Royce...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Splendid!! A bond of trust that conquers even the greatest hardships!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
It's a pity about the Satsuki Sho, but...
we have high hopes for the Japan Derby!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you very much.
I apologize for causing such a commotion.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"The level of competition in the Classic races is no joke.
Many end up giving up every year due to the sheer difficulty, but
witnessing it firsthand really drives it home..."

text_block_list.name: Sports Newspaper Article
text_block_list.text:
"‘The Light and Shadow of the Satsuki Sho—
Royce and Royce Withdraws from the Race.
A Tearful Appeal to Her Trainer.’"

text_block_list.name: Online News Article
text_block_list.text: "Aiming for the Japanese Derby through the bond with her trainer. Lois and Lois's 'Strongest' Road."

The next day, the drama surrounding Royce and Royce's scratched race
was picked up by newspapers and online news outlets alike.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the race fans' reactions are great too!
Everyone's feeling sympathetic toward me.
choice_data_list: Glad they didn't realize I was acting...

text_block_list.text:
“—Yes, that whole commotion at the press conference
announcing her entry into the Satsuki Sho was all staged.”
In order to capture the attention of the media and fans, it was staged as a drama of setback and adversity.

And the reason this setback struck the fans so deeply
was because of the persona she had built before her debut.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: We need to leave a strong impression on racing fans as a rookie Umamusume full of promise.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...With my current ability, the time will surely come
when I will taste bitter defeat.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Just imagine. An Umamusume full of hope
hits a wall... and her spirit shatters.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: —It's dramatic to the utmost degree, wouldn't you say?

Never letting a fall go to waste. No,
she had even anticipated falling and positioned herself accordingly.
choice_data_list: Honestly, it was nothing short of magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. But it's too early to celebrate.
The real problem starts now.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "In the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby), I must leave an impression that surpasses even the Umamusume who ran in the Satsuki Sho."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Still, the attention on an Umamusume
who puts on a great show in the Satsuki Sho is unreal.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: There are plenty of times when the 2nd and 3rd place finishers of the Satsuki Sho are seen as stronger contenders than an Umamusume who won a Junior Class GⅠ.
choice_data_list: We need one more trick before the Derby.
We need one more trick before the Derby, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I plan to steal the spotlight with a daring challenge
that race fans won't be able to resist.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Via the "Aoba Sho route", of course!

The Aoba Sho is a trial race for the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby)
held after the Satsuki Sho. However—

In all of history, no Umamusume who won the Aoba Sho
has ever gone on to claim victory in the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby).
They say the strain of running 2,400 meters—a grueling distance for this time of year—with so little turnaround time between races is taking its toll.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If I declare a challenge for an untouched record,
the racing fans will definitely focus all eyes on me!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: First... 1st place in the Aoba Sho.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"If we can't achieve that,
the entire production plan falls apart."
choice_data_list: I'll lead you to victory, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm counting on you.
I will definitely make this production a success!
